# HierarchicalCrackPatternGeneration

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Algorithms that simulate the formation of multi-scale, hierarchical crack networks in drying films by iteratively applying planar network generation rules. Provides a bio-inspired, self-organizing approach to generating complex planar topologies that could inform the design of adaptive, fault-tolerant network architectures in TCC.
